motion.lesson: Master upper-body gesture precedes trainee windup and strike; target recoil and beat markers follow contact

motion.inputs: Additional move/enter commands are rejected during travel. Esc/gamepad cancel reverses entry or cancels travel to its source stage before returning to the entrance. Arrival gestures do not delay further navigation.
motion.audio: Authored presentation AudioSource uses existing wood sounds plus editor-baked TrainingFootstep and SummitGust. Title music source and gameplay DSP scheduling are untouched.
